workflow.name: Turn Google Tasks into n8n Plans with Slack Approval & Archiving
workflow.description: Daily schedule trigger fetches new Google Tasks ideas, uses GPT to design n8n workflow plans, sends them to Slack for approval, archives approved plans to Google Sheets, and marks tasks as processed.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI GPT used to generate n8n workflow plans

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for solution architecture generation

SLACK_CHANNEL_ID.description: Slack channel ID for sending review messages (mocked)

GOOGLE_TASKS_LIST_ID.description: Google Tasks list ID to fetch ideas from (mocked)

GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID.description: Google Sheets document ID for archiving (mocked)

SLACK_AUTO_APPROVE.description: Set to 'true' to auto-approve Slack reviews without human interaction

workflow_steps.name: Schedule Trigger
workflow_steps.description: Daily trigger at 9am to start the workflow. Inline in run_workflow.py; no MCP tool needed.

workflow_steps.name: Get New Ideas
workflow_steps.description: Fetch up to 5 tasks from mock Google Tasks list

workflow_steps.name: Filter Processed
workflow_steps.description: Remove tasks whose notes already contain '✅ Processed'

workflow_steps.name: Iterate Ideas
workflow_steps.description: Iterate through each filtered idea one by one (SplitInBatches equivalent). Inline loop in run_workflow.py; no MCP tool needed.

workflow_steps.name: AI Solution Architect
workflow_steps.description: GPT designs a complete n8n workflow plan for the idea: title, nodes, challenges, improvements, alternatives, slack_message

workflow_steps.name: Slack Review & Approve
workflow_steps.description: Send AI plan to Slack channel and wait for Approve or Regenerate response (mocked)

workflow_steps.name: Check Approval
workflow_steps.description: Check if the Slack response is 'Approve' or 'Regenerate'

workflow_steps.name: Archive to Sheets
workflow_steps.description: Append approved idea data to mock Google Sheets CSV file

workflow_steps.name: Mark as Notified
workflow_steps.description: Update task notes to '✅ Processed' in mock Google Tasks
